sources.title: Ofcom proposes to block new Openreach commercial offer to protect fair competition and keep long-term prices low
sources.geography: United Kingdom fixed wholesale telecoms markets
facts: Ofcom provisionally proposes withdrawal of one Openreach offer
The regulator is not proposing intervention for the other notified offers
limitations: The position is provisional while consultation is open
Wholesale pricing evidence is not premises coverage

sources.title: How to protect yourself from scam calls, texts and messages
facts: The page recommends stop, check and report actions
Suspicious texts can be forwarded to 7726
limitations: Preventive guidance does not authenticate a contact
Reports do not establish sender identity

sources.title: We’ve updated our mobile and broadband checker
facts: The checker covers mobile availability and broadband services by address
Mobile predictions come from the four UK mobile network operators
limitations: Predicted results can differ from actual experience

sources.title: Affordability of communications services
facts: The page summarises Ofcom affordability research
It tracks awareness and take-up of broadband social tariffs
limitations: Affordability evidence does not determine individual eligibility

sources.title: Saving money
facts: The index lists contract, switching, price-rise and tariff guidance
It records publication and update dates for current advice
limitations: An index does not replace underlying guidance
Listed content does not prove a personal entitlement
